name: bitrouter
description: Route model calls through BitRouter and delegate long-running, parallel workflows to BRO Goals with ACP-compatible harnesses. Native and managed ACP Goal workers share Thread/Turn ownership; generic session controls cannot take over managed Turns. The skill documents bounded model-admission waiting, safe native checkpoint continuation, and remaining ACP recovery/budget-wait limits. The bro and bro code interfaces show Goals, current-Goal input and a read-only Workflow. Native harness launchers, headless run, native BRO ACP v1/v2 and transparent external acp serve and separately privileged native task APIs remain available. Bundles the BitRouter setup and operations skill. Finished scoped local work has evidence-gated recovery; unresolved effects remain blocked. Tasks can select acknowledged BRO model routes, configured MCP and versioned skill/context material; supplied configuration does not prove actual use. Current-Goal worker/resource edits are versioned; old attempts retain their requested worker and replacement waits for stop/effect reconciliation. Unresolved Goal inputs persist across queries; exact input references and reasoned dispositions preserve scope. Exact input withdrawal remains available without a model; Goal IPC v7 does not replay older outboxes.
